best_match.fbbt_definition: For image, see FBrf0211729. Adult uniglomerular antennal lobe projection neuron from the ad neuroblast lineage with dendrites that mainly innervate antennal lobe glomerulus DM6. This is the 11th cell type to be generated post-embryonically by neuroblast ALad1 (Yu et al., 2010). There are around three of these per hemisphere, they fasciculate with the medial antennal lobe tract and they are cholinergic (Yu et al., 2010; Bates et al., 2020).
